name: add_folder
description: Register a folder as a Cairn notes folder, creating the directory if it doesn't exist.

path.description: Filesystem path to the notes folder

name.description: Name to register it under; defaults to the folder's basename

name: list_folders
description: List every Cairn notes folder that CLI/MCP access has been granted for.

name: get_notes
description: List the markdown notes in a notes folder.

subfolders.description: Include notes in subfolders (default: top-level only)

name: get_note
description: Read the contents of a note. The result's mtimeMs can be passed back as ifUnmodifiedSince to update_note/set_note/set_properties/delete_note to avoid clobbering a change made since this read.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

name: add_note
description: Create a new note with a title. Auto-renames on a title collision instead of overwriting - use set_note if you want to create-or-overwrite a note at an exact path. Pass either content or template, not both.

subfolder.description: Subfolder to create the note in, created if missing

template.description: Name of a custom file template in this notes folder's .templates folder (see get_notes) to render instead of content - {{placeholders}} filled from values, plus {{date}}/{{time}}/{{datetime}}.

name: set_note
description: Create or overwrite a note at an exact path. Use this to maintain a specific memory file you expect to keep writing back to.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: An mtimeMs from an earlier get_note/get_properties call on this note. If the note changed since, the write is rejected instead of overwriting it. Ignored when the note doesn't exist yet.

name: update_note
description: Append text to an existing note - either at the end of the file, or at the end of a specific heading's section.

heading.description: Insert at the end of this heading's section instead of end-of-file

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: An mtimeMs from an earlier get_note/get_properties call on this note. If the note changed since, the write is rejected instead of overwriting it.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: An mtimeMs from an earlier get_note/get_properties call. If the note changed since, the delete is rejected.

name: search_notes
description: Search note contents for a query, returning matching lines grouped by note.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression instead of a plain substring

name: get_backlinks
description: List notes that wikilink/markdown-link to a note (excludes notes that only share a tag - use get_tags for that).

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

name: get_tags
description: List every tag in a notes folder, each with the notes that carry it.

name: get_properties
description: Read a note's frontmatter properties. The result's mtimeMs can be passed back as ifUnmodifiedSince to update_note/set_note/set_properties/delete_note to avoid clobbering a change made since this read.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

name: set_properties
description: Merge values into a note's frontmatter properties (JSON Merge Patch semantics). Existing properties not mentioned are left untouched; a property set to null is removed.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

properties.description: Properties to set; a value of null removes that key

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: An mtimeMs from an earlier get_note/get_properties call on this note. If the note changed since, the write is rejected instead of overwriting it.

name: get_note_history
description: List local version snapshots recorded for a note, newest first. Each entry's timestamp can be passed to restore_note_version.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

name: restore_note_version
description: Overwrite a note with one of its recorded history snapshots (see get_note_history). The note's current content is itself snapshotted first, so this can be undone.

notePath.description: Path relative to the notes folder root

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: An mtimeMs from an earlier get_note/get_properties call. If the note changed since, the restore is rejected.

name: get_orphaned_attachments
description: List attachments (files under the notes folder's attachments/ folder) that no note currently embeds via ![](path) - candidates for delete_orphaned_attachments.

name: delete_orphaned_attachments
description: Delete every attachment no note currently embeds (recomputed fresh, see get_orphaned_attachments).
